verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only coarse status signals. Jules notifies you when a task completes or needs your input, it surfaces a plan for review before making changes, and a user reported seeing a status message when a task timed out. Nothing documents a live view of what the agent is doing as it runs. Missing for 10: a real-time activity or log stream of agent actions, a documented live status indicator in the UI or API, and independent hands-on confirmation of live monitoring.
